title: Balanced coherence of canonical coefficient pullback comparisons
statement: In the setting and notation of def-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-data, fix already constructed e:Comparisons(g,nY,nX) and multiplication units uY,uX. Then the inverse-image comparisons commute with the balanced scalar associators and multiplication units, precisely PullbackCoherence(g,nY,nX,e,uY,uX). This is a coherence result for already constructed inverse-image/tensor maps; it contains neither construction of e nor a law about its direct-image mate. All scalar, associator, inverse-image and mate shift equations are proved separately.

source.place: Tag 0D6D, common K-flat representatives for pullback composition; explicit balanced double-tensor and scalar multiplication calculations.

proof.text: Represent each derived input by a flat-term K-flat complex. Use the existing computation-isomorphism and inverse-image preservation lemmas. Scalar extension preserves this representative class by ringed-topos pullback for the identity inverse image.

The composite scalar-extension and inverse-image adjunctions make equality detectable after scalar insertion. The normalization of ordinary scalar associators identifies double insertion with composite insertion. The ordinary_insertion equations and naturality then prove the ordinary composition square, including rings.map_comp transport. On the chosen complexes combine this square with naturality, the representative equations of Comparisons and Normalization, and cancellation of invertible computation maps. Extend equality from these representatives by naturality and the quasi-isomorphism from a K-flat resolution.

The multiplication normalization identifies insertion followed by either ordinary unit with the identity. Composite-adjunction injectivity and ordinary_insertion give the ordinary unit square, including rings.map_id transport. Apply the unit representative formulas and naturality of the exact inverse-image derived comparison. Cancel its invertible factor and extend from flat-term K-flat representatives by a resolution.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0D6D, common K-flat representatives for pullback composition. M6: ordinary coherence from insertion normalization and composite-adjunction injectivity; derived coherence from representative equations and naturality, with explicit map_comp and map_id transports.
